# eon_restore_encryption_keys (Data Source)

Lists encryption keys available to a restore account in a region.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "eon_restore_encryption_keys" "example" {
  restore_account_id       = "restore-account-id"
  region                   = "us-east-1"
  include_aws_managed_keys = true
}

output "restore_encryption_keys" {
  value = data.eon_restore_encryption_keys.example.keys
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `region` (String) AWS region to list encryption keys in.
- `restore_account_id` (String) Eon restore account ID.

### Optional

- `include_aws_managed_keys` (Boolean) Whether to include AWS-managed encryption keys.

### Read-Only

- `keys` (Attributes List) Encryption keys available in the region. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--keys))

<a id="nestedatt--keys"></a>
### Nested Schema for `keys`

Read-Only:

- `alias_name` (String) Encryption key alias.
- `arn` (String) Encryption key ARN.
- `id` (String) Encryption key ID.
